title: Google Ads for Veterinary Clinics: A New Client Guide | Improtics

facts.fact: The page's author, Vasant Chaudhary, states he has managed $30M+ across 50+ e-commerce and agency accounts in the US, UK and India.
facts.quote: Google Ads specialist. $30M+ managed across 50+ e-commerce and agency accounts in the US, UK and India.

facts.fact: The article is listed as a 20-minute read.
The page's diagram lists seven campaign types for a veterinary clinic Google Ads account, with Exotics included only if the clinic offers exotic pets.
facts.quote: Google Ads campaign structure for veterinary clinics: Brand Search, New client and near me, Wellness and vaccines, Dental, Surgery and spay and neuter, Emergency and urgent care, and Exotics

facts.fact: The page states that a veterinary client relationship can last ten years or more.
facts.quote: Both searches start a relationship that can last ten years or more.

facts.fact: The guide says emergency-hospital ads should run only when the hospital is open and staffed.
facts.quote: Ads run when the hospital is open and staffed

facts.fact: The guide says a general practice day clinic should be judged on cost per new client seen.
facts.quote: Judge on cost per new client seen
